why:
Operator ruling, 2026-09-26 (compare-spec 2.16.0): a single Accept on its own or accompanied only by Rejects is processed as an auto-match decision -- also when registry-search recovery, not the vendor, supplied the candidates. Until then the NOMATCH branch sent every recovered Accept to a reviewer as 'Disagree: Tamr missed', even with an anchoring identity Alt ID and nothing else credible in the pool. The SAME auto-match gates apply as for a sole Accept on a vendor shortlist (anchor, participants, duration, year gap, registry-side Alt-ID multiplicity), so a gated sole Accept is still reported for review.

SCOPE: pins that a clean sole Accept with only Reject rivals CLEARS. Its companion recovered-accept-with-review-rival-is-reviewed pins that any Review-band rival keeps the row with a reviewer.

expected.reason: Tamr found no match; a registry search found a single high-scoring record and every other candidate scores Reject. Auto-accepted — no review needed.
